description: Fetch a worked-example Ptally project for a common line of business. Each example is a small, fully valid project with realistic collection tables, calculations, exclusions and refers, plus an embedded tests[] suite for reference. Use as a template — copy and adapt rather than authoring from scratch. Pass no arguments (or `list: true`) to get the catalog.

list.description: When true (or when type is omitted), return the catalog of available examples with their descriptions instead of a single project.
